mapper.select: select id, user_id, sign_in_date, consecutive_days, create_time from sign_in_record where user_id = #{userId} order by sign_in_date desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sign_in_record(user_id, sign_in_date, consecutive_days, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{signInDate}, #{consecutiveDays}, now())
